review_model.classification: Every commit is assigned once. Platform exemptions use reviewed cfg/module/dependency evidence. Nonruntime buckets use dedicated paths and reviewed inline-test diffs. Shared buckets are conservative queues; those commits have not all received a complete semantic audit.
review_model.preserve_parity: Grouping guides review and validation. It is not an instruction to drop excluded platform commits or cherry-pick groups independently; commit dependencies and full upstream ancestry still matter.
review_model.compile_boundary: Runtime-disabled plugins/reporting do not automatically exclude their Rust crates or shared interfaces from compilation. Windows/macOS/Linux behavior is low native-runtime priority only where the applicable target gates were checked.
review_model.historical_context: A platform-oriented commit title alone is not proof of exclusion; a tests/CI title may hide production changes.

foreign_platform_only.title: Other-platform production only
foreign_platform_only.meaning: Reviewed production behavior is excluded by Windows/macOS/Linux target gates on native target_os=trueos. Test-only and platform build/CI commits are counted in their respective nonruntime groups.
foreign_platform_only.action: Retain the upstream implementation behind its target gates, translate folded imports/file locations as needed, and check shared interfaces. A native TRUEOS test run does not validate Windows/macOS/Linux execution.

shared_runtime_other.title: Shared runtime or mixed changes outside detected custom paths
